content: CSV/spreadsheet import template best practice: ship both an empty template (headers only) and a filled sample-row template, to avoid users accidentally importing the example data. Match imported columns by header name/label in a mapping UI rather than by raw column position, so the template can tolerate reordered or extra columns. Clearly mark required vs optional columns in the template/docs; missing a required column should fail fast with a clear message rather than partially importing malformed data.
